## Focus

- AI office agents for trades and small businesses: calls, email, quotes, receipts
- Automation between existing business software, with human approval
- Company-knowledge assistants that answer from the client's own documents, with sources
- Websites that bring enquiries; AI training for teams

## Case studies

- Zohir, B2B car trade: purchase bots, CarFleet vehicle tool, Griffi document archive
- Medivaro Pflege: website and care-box application flow into the billing portal
- Michael Groß Meisterbetrieb (heating and plumbing): website
- HaliAvrupa: Shopify shop build
- Griffi (own product): digital office assistant for trades, https://griffi.ai
- Global DAX industrial group (freelance): AI platform for 26,000+ governance documents
